milestone.title: Settings lane UX polish — boolean dot, choice chip strip, legend consistency pass

intent.outcome: Settings rows show their value visually: booleans as a ●/○ dot, choices as a clickable chip strip from the schema's allowed list (ui.theme keeps M243's picker). Enter no longer opens an editor for bool/choice rows, and the per-tab footer legend is consistent, with read-only lanes declared explicitly and covered by a test.

problem.description: crates/raul/src/tui/render/overlays.rs::render_settings_list (~636, [bool]/[choice] spans ~725) renders every boolean as '[bool] true|false' and every choice as '[choice] <value>' even though Space already toggles and the schema (from mp config schema) carries the full allowed list. Enter on these rows opens the text editor, which adds nothing. The per-tab footer table (crates/raul/src/tui/keybinds.rs::footer_per_tab, ~998) shows section/item navigation for Milestones · Detail but not Backlog · Detail although both bind the same keys, and Lane::Path returns an empty row with no marker saying that is intentional.

in_scope: Bool rows: single ● (palette.success) / ○ (palette.dim) instead of the text; click or Space toggles.

Choice rows (except ui.theme, which renders M243's picker): one chip per schema allowed value; active chip in palette.accent + bold + reversed, others palette.foreground; overflow ends in a palette.dim '…'; the description card lists all values. Click selects a chip; ←/→ cycle via the existing SettingsCycleChoice action.
Mouse hit rects for dots and chips through tui/mouse.rs.
Enter is a no-op on bool and choice rows (no SettingsFocus::Editing); the hint line reads 'Space/click: toggle · s: save · Esc: back' (bool) and '←/→/click: cycle · s: save · Esc: back' (choice).

Footer legend: Backlog · Detail shows the same section / item / annotate / menu / approve glyphs as Milestones · Detail for keys bound in both; add `const READ_ONLY_FOOTER_LANES: &[Lane] = &[Lane::Path]` in keybinds.rs, and a unit test that every (lane, content state) footer is non-empty unless its lane is in that const.
New integration tests in crates/raul/tests/tui_settings_rows.rs; footer tests as unit tests in keybinds.rs.
out_of_scope: New schema types or changes to mp config / mp config schema.
Refactoring SettingsFocus internals beyond skipping Editing for bool/choice.
Mouse plumbing beyond the dots and chips.
Rebinding any keys (footer_per_tab only renders existing bindings).

acceptance_criteria.description: Bool rows render a single ● (success) / ○ (dim) with no 'true'/'false' text; click and Space toggle in place.
Choice rows other than ui.theme render one chip per schema allowed value (active: accent + bold + reversed); click selects a chip; ←/→ cycle.
A chip strip wider than the row ends in a dim '…' and the description card lists every allowed value.
Enter on bool and choice rows does not enter the editor; the hint line shows the per-type live-action verbs.
Backlog · Detail's footer lists the same section / item / annotate / menu / approve glyphs as Milestones · Detail for keys bound in both.
Every (lane, content state) footer row is non-empty unless the lane is listed in READ_ONLY_FOOTER_LANES (which contains Lane::Path).
acceptance_criteria.verification: rg -q 'READ_ONLY_FOOTER_LANES' crates/raul/src/tui/keybinds.rs && cargo nextest run -p raul --no-fail-fast -E 'test(/footer_no_unexplained_empty/)'

acceptance_criteria.description: raul tests, clippy, fmt, and consumer-surface lint are clean.
acceptance_criteria.verification: cargo nextest run -p raul --no-fail-fast && cargo clippy -p raul --all-targets --no-deps -- -D warnings && cargo fmt --all -- --check && make consumer-surface-lint

work_packages.name: Boolean dot
work_packages.goal: Render bool rows as a single dot replacing the [bool] true string. Click hit-test toggles in place.
work_packages.rollback: Restore text rendering and drop the hit-test for the dot.

work_packages.name: Choice chip strip
work_packages.goal: Render choice rows as a chip strip from schema allowed. Click and arrow keys select. Ellipsis on overflow.
work_packages.rollback: Restore text rendering and drop chip click handler.

work_packages.name: Editor skip + hint
work_packages.goal: Bool and choice rows do NOT open an editor on Enter. Description card hint line updates to live-action verbs.

work_packages.name: Legend consistency + verify
work_packages.goal: Backlog Detail parity with Milestones Detail; Path empty per-tab is intentional; new fixture catches empty strings.
work_packages.rollback: Drop the parity fix; revert the new fixture.

steps.action: render_settings_list: bool rows render ● (palette.success) / ○ (palette.dim) instead of the text span.
Hit rect for the bool dot via tui/mouse.rs; click toggles; Space unchanged.
render_settings_list: choice rows (except ui.theme) render a chip strip from the schema allowed list; active chip accent + bold + reversed.
Chip overflow: render up to the row width, then a dim '…'; description card lists all allowed values.
Hit rects for each chip via tui/mouse.rs; click stages that value; ←/→ cycle through the existing SettingsCycleChoice.
Per-type hint line: 'Space/click: toggle · s: save · Esc: back' (bool), '←/→/click: cycle · s: save · Esc: back' (choice).
Enter on bool / choice rows is a no-op (skip SettingsFocus::Editing).
footer_per_tab: give Backlog · Detail the same section / item / annotate / menu / approve glyphs as Milestones · Detail for keys bound in both; unit test footer_backlog_detail_parity.
Add const READ_ONLY_FOOTER_LANES: &[Lane] = &[Lane::Path] and unit test footer_no_unexplained_empty iterating every (lane, content state).
steps.tests: rg -q 'READ_ONLY_FOOTER_LANES' crates/raul/src/tui/keybinds.rs && cargo nextest run -p raul --no-fail-fast -E 'test(/footer_no_unexplained_empty/)'

steps.action: Final verify: raul nextest, clippy, fmt, consumer-surface lint; CHANGELOG entry.
